items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Walter was a good time keeper... he will keep the rhythm going. But, he would hold things together.

ctx.x: I mean -- what did he contribute that was sort of special?

Well, let's see. Walter was a good time keeper. Plus, he would, you know, along with the time, he would keep the -- keep, doing alot of breaks and solos in between, see. And, whatever amount of choruses he has, he'll be playing -- he'll play some times in between, and then he will keep the rhythm going. But, he would hold things together.
Because, Freddie, wasn't that before bass players really took choruses. See -- I mean they didn't take whole choruses in those days.
